title: This Has Never Happened Before
description: $BTC just did something it has never done in its history, and one weekly close decides whether 2026 ends up with two crypto winters.

I walk through the 50-week and 200-week SMAs, every bear market since 2014, why Fear and Greed fell from 78 to 18, the Nvidia, Anthropic and Fed news behind the selling, and the one coin that didn't flinch.
